headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, led by AI‑driven firms, but profit momentum varied.
summary: Revenue rose across the board, with TCS, HCLTech and Tech Mahindra posting double‑digit YoY gains. Profit growth was uneven; TCS and Coforge delivered strong margins, while Infosys trimmed guidance and Persistent saw profit decline. AI revenue is becoming a material contributor, especially for HCLTech and Wipro. Dividend payouts remained robust for most peers.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Companies reporting AI revenue (HCLTech, Wipro, TCS) highlighted it as a key driver of deal wins and margin expansion.

themes.title: Margin pressure at larger peers
themes.detail: Infosys and Wipro posted modest or slipping margins despite revenue growth, prompting guidance cuts or cautious outlooks.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and operating margin, strong profit growth.
53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance.
AI‑driven sales lifted profit 21% YoY and solid margin expansion.

laggards.why: Revenue grew but profit fell 27% QoQ, indicating cost pressure.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance was cut.
Profit slipped despite revenue growth, margin flat.
